                AND = {
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_exit_pip_present = 1
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_exit_pip_owner = var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_receipt_prior_pip_owner

                }
            }
            var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_present = var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_receipt_misconduct_present

                AND = {
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_present = 0

                    has_variable = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_receipt_misconduct_evidence_hash
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_case_id > 0
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_case_hash > 0

                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_evidence_hash > 0
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_case_id = var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_receipt_misconduct_case_id

                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_evidence_id = var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_receipt_misconduct_evidence_id
                    var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_misconduct_evidence_hash = var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_receipt_misconduct_evidence_hash
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_status value = 2 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_red_code value = 27611 }
        debug_log = "ZG361WRF RED 27611: canonical normal-exit provider is absent, stale or colliding"
    }
}

# probation/result receipt.  The growth employer must differ from the old
# exit owner, so pre-exit/current-employer evidence cannot masquerade as
# outside growth.  State=1 proves the exit hook happened first.

}

# Call only after Workforce route A/B returned.  The exact operation
# receipt and seven business outputs are the acknowledgement.  Route C did
# not consume history and therefore cannot finalize this record.
zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_finalize_m276_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state = 3

            var:zg361_we_ad_external_rehire_historical_case_id = var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_historical_case_id
